name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The name of the type. This is the primary identifier for the component.

description.description.beginner: A detailed description of what this type represents and how it should be used.

icon.description.beginner: An icon to visually represent this type. Can be an emoji, icon name, or URL to an image.

image.label: Image
image.description.beginner: URL to an image that represents this type. Used for previews and visual identification.

variant.label: Variant
variant.description.beginner: Variant name for this type. Variants allow multiple configurations of the same type.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description.beginner: The unit of measurement used for this type (e.g., mm, m, ft).

url.label: URL
url.description.beginner: URL to a 3D model, image, or other resource representing this type.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A description of what this representation shows or how it should be used.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description.beginner: Tags to categorize and filter representations (e.g., 'detailed', 'simplified', 'lod1').

id.label: ID
id.description.beginner: Unique identifier for this port. Used to reference the port in connections.

family.label: Family
family.description.beginner: Port family name. Ports of the same family can connect to each other.

compatibleFamilies.label: Compatible Families
compatibleFamilies.description.beginner: List of other port families this port can connect to. Leave empty to allow all families.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A description of what this port represents and how it should be used for connections.

t.label: T
t.description.beginner: Position on the diagram ring (0-1). Controls where the port appears in the 2D diagram view.

x.label: X
x.description.beginner: X coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

y.label: Y
y.description.beginner: Y coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

z.label: Z
z.description.beginner: Z coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

x.label: X
x.description.beginner: X position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.

y.label: Y
y.description.beginner: Y position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.

z.label: Z
z.description.beginner: Z position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.
